plain: BoardColumn no longer takes a tone or paints a status dot, and the --hds-accent-bar variable is gone.

steps.plain: Delete the BoardColumnTone import and the tone prop from every BoardColumn, and drop any var(--hds-accent-bar); status lives in the column title and count.
Delete every var(--hds-accent-bar); status is shown in the content, not a coloured bar.
